## BioProject
```{r}
animals_vaccines_bioproject_result <- read_csv("animals_vaccines_bioproject_result.csv", 
    col_names = FALSE)
datacuration_clean = animals_vaccines_bioproject_result %>%
 drop_na() %>% 
  mutate(study = if_else(X1 =="Title", X2, NA)) %>% 
  fill(study, .direction = c("down")) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = X1, values_from = X2) %>% 
  select(-study) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  mutate(title = str_remove(title, "^\\d+\\.\\s"),
         organism = str_remove(organism, "Organism: "),
         organism = str_remove(organism, "Taxonomy ID "),
         bio_project_accession = str_remove(bio_project_accession, "BioProject Accession: "),
         id = str_remove(id, "ID: "))

datacuration_clean

datacuration_clean %>% 
  write_csv(here("tables", "datacuration_step2.csv"))
```

GEO
```{r}
library(glue)
#Single ------
# query NCBI GEO 
geo_ids <- "GSE199750"
terms <- entrez_db_searchable(db = "gds")  # for reference: searchable fields
# first, get additional information about this series, including its db ID.
series <- entrez_search("gds",
                        term = glue("{geo_ids}[ACCN] AND gse[ETYP]"))
# use the ID to fetch details, including the sample table
series_summary = entrez_summary(db = "gds", id = series$ids)
series_summary_df = data_frame(bioproject = series_summary$bioproject,
                               uid = series_summary$uid,
                               gse= series_summary$gse,
                               gds= series_summary$gds,
                               title= series_summary$title,
                               summary= series_summary$summary,
                               gpl= series_summary$gpl,
                               n_samples= series_summary$n_samples,
                               platformtitle= series_summary$platformtitle)

#Multiple -------

gse_ids <- str_extract_all(conteudo, "GSE\\d+\\b") %>% unlist() %>% unique()


geo_metadata_df <- map_dfr(gse_ids, ~ {
  result <- entrez_search("gds", term = glue("{.x}[ACCN] AND gse[ETYP]"))

  if (length(result$ids) == 0) {
    return(tibble(gse = .x, error = "Not found"))
  }

  summary <- entrez_summary(db = "gds", id = result$ids)

  tibble(
    gse = .x,
    uid = summary$uid,
    gds = summary$gds,
    bioproject = summary$bioproject,
    title = summary$title,
    summary_text = summary$summary,
    gpl = summary$gpl,
    n_samples = summary$n_samples,
    platformtitle = summary$platformtitle
  ) %>% 
    mutate(bioproject_id = str_remove(bioproject, "PRJNA"))
})
print(geo_metadata_df)
```

# MouseImmuneGO

## Gene sets construction


### Blood transcription modules <https://www.nature.com/articles/ni.2789>

```{r}
#Converter ítens de "Module member genes" em linhas em uma tabela longa
btm_annotation_table_long_immune <- BTM_modules %>%
  separate_rows(`Module member genes`, sep = ",") %>% 
  filter(`Module category` == "immune")

#Salvar
write.csv(btm_annotation_table_long_immune, file = "btm_annotation_table_long_immune.csv")

#Display
head(btm_annotation_table_long_immune)

#Calculate Set size
btm_annotation_nested <- btm_annotation_table_long_immune %>%
  group_by(`Module title`) %>% #Somar e agrupar
  mutate(SetSize = n())

#Convert gene symbol column to aggregated rows
btm_annotation_nested <- btm_annotation_nested %>%
  group_by(`Module title`) %>%
  summarize(Genes = paste(`Module member genes`, collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  left_join(btm_annotation_nested, by = "Module title") %>% 
  filter(Genes != "NA") %>% 
  relocate(Genes, .after="SetSize")

#Salvar
write.csv(btm_annotation_nested, file = "btm_annotation_genes.csv")

#Convert to unique values table
btm_annotation_unique = btm_annotation_nested %>% 
  dplyr::select(-`Module member genes`)

btm_annotation_unique = btm_annotation_unique %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  relocate(Genes, .after="SetSize") %>% 
  filter(Genes != "NA")

#salvar
write.csv(btm_annotation_unique, file = "btm_annotation_unique.csv")

#Display
head(btm_annotation_unique)

btm_annotation_table_long_immune
```

### CellMarker

Download database from
"<http://117.50.127.228/CellMarker/CellMarker_download_files/file/Cell_marker_Human.xlsx>"

```{r}
##################### Baixar tabela de marcadores celulares

url <- "http://117.50.127.228/CellMarker/CellMarker_download_files/file/Cell_marker_Human.xlsx" 
f <- tempfile(fileext = ".xlsx")
download.file(url, f)
cell_marker_data <- readxl::read_excel(f, 1)

##################### Sub-agrupar células por sistema imunológico

#Filtrar marcadores e células por tecido (Blood)
cells <- cell_marker_data %>%
    filter(tissue_class == "Blood") %>%
    dplyr::select(cell_name, marker)

##################### Filtrar células
# Acessar todos os tipos de células no dataset de Blood
cellmarker_celltypes <- unique(cells$cell_name)

# Filtrar apenas os tipos que contêm "B cell" e plasmacell
Bcells_no = cellmarker_celltypes[grep("B cell", cellmarker_celltypes)] #44 outputs
Plasmacells_no = cellmarker_celltypes[grep("plasma", cellmarker_celltypes)] #5 outputs

# Filtrar apenas os tipos que contêm "T cell" e seus subtipos "CD4" e "CD8"
Tcells_no = cellmarker_celltypes[grep("T cell", cellmarker_celltypes)] #93 outputs
TCD4_no = cellmarker_celltypes[grep("CD4", cellmarker_celltypes)] #35 outputs
TCD8_no = cellmarker_celltypes[grep("CD8", cellmarker_celltypes)] #34 outputs
Treg_no = cellmarker_celltypes[grep("Treg", cellmarker_celltypes)] #7 outputs
Thelper_no = cellmarker_celltypes[grep("helper", cellmarker_celltypes)] #17 outputs

# Filtrar outros tipos celulares da resposta imune
Neutrophils_no = cellmarker_celltypes[grep("neutrophil", cellmarker_celltypes)] #7 outputs
Monocyte_no = cellmarker_celltypes[grep("monocyte", cellmarker_celltypes)] #14 outputs
DCells_no = cellmarker_celltypes[grep("dendritic", cellmarker_celltypes)] #25 outputs
Macrophages_no = cellmarker_celltypes[grep("macrophage", cellmarker_celltypes)] #7 outputs
NKcells_no = cellmarker_celltypes[grep("killer", cellmarker_celltypes)] # 11 outputs
Neutrophils_no = cellmarker_celltypes[grep("mastcell", cellmarker_celltypes)] #7 outputs

# Criar variáveis para cada célula para enriquecimento

# Filtrar apenas as células da resposta imune adaptativa
Bcells <- filter(cells, str_detect(cell_name, regex("B cell|plasma cell|plasmablast", ignore_case = TRUE)))
TCD4 <- filter(cells, str_detect(cell_name, regex("CD4", ignore_case = TRUE)))
TCD8 <- filter(cells, str_detect(cell_name, regex("CD8", ignore_case = TRUE)))
Treg <- filter(cells, str_detect(cell_name, regex("Treg", ignore_case = TRUE)))
Thelper <- filter(cells, str_detect(cell_name, regex("helper", ignore_case = TRUE)))


# Filtrar células da resposta imune inata
Neutrophils <- filter(cells, str_detect(cell_name, regex("neutrophil", ignore_case = TRUE)))
Monocyte <- filter(cells, str_detect(cell_name, regex("monocyte", ignore_case = TRUE)))
DCells <- filter(cells, str_detect(cell_name, regex("dendritic", ignore_case = TRUE)))
Macrophages <- filter(cells, str_detect(cell_name, regex("macrophage", ignore_case = TRUE)))
Mastcells <- filter(cells, str_detect(cell_name, regex("mast cell", ignore_case = TRUE)))
NKcells <- filter(cells, str_detect(cell_name, regex("killer", ignore_case = TRUE)))
Platelets <- filter(cells, str_detect(cell_name, regex("Platelet", ignore_case = TRUE)))
Eosinophil <- filter(cells, str_detect(cell_name, regex("Eosinophil", ignore_case = TRUE)))
Basophil <- filter(cells, str_detect(cell_name, regex("Basophil", ignore_case = TRUE)))
Granulocyte <- filter(cells, str_detect(cell_name, regex("Granulocyte", ignore_case = TRUE)))

#Agrupar todos os resultados em Immune cells
Immune_adap = rbind(Bcells, TCD4, TCD8, Treg, Thelper)
Immune_adap$Type = "Adaptive"

Immune_innate = rbind(Neutrophils, Monocyte, DCells, Macrophages, Mastcells, NKcells, Platelets, Eosinophil, Basophil, Granulocyte)
Immune_innate$Type = "Innate"

#Unir tabelas
Immune_cells = rbind(Immune_adap, Immune_innate) 

#Salvar
write.csv(Immune_cells, file = "CellMarker_ImmuneCells.csv")

esquisser(Immune_cells_markersbycells)
```

### ImmuneGO

```{r}
organism = "org.Mm.eg.db"
# install.packages("GO.db")
BiocManager::install(organism, character.only = TRUE)
library(organism, character.only = TRUE)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(GO.db)

#HGNC symbol to Entrez
x <- org.Mm.egSYMBOL
mapped_genes <- mappedkeys(x)
symbols_entrez <- as.data.frame(x[mapped_genes])

## Entrez to GO
x <- org.Mm.egGO
mapped_genes <- mappedkeys(x)
entrez_geneontology <- as.data.frame(x[mapped_genes])

## GO BP ancestors
go_bp_ancestor = GOBPANCESTOR %>% 
  as.data.frame()
colnames(go_bp_ancestor)[1] <- "go_id"
colnames(go_bp_ancestor)[2] <- "go_ancestor"

## GO ID to terms
go_bp = AnnotationDbi::select(GO.db, columns=c("GOID","TERM"), keys= "BP", keytype= "ONTOLOGY") %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  dplyr::select(go_id = goid, term)

## GO child and ancestor
go_bp_ancestor = go_bp_ancestor %>% 
  inner_join(go_bp %>% rename(go_ancestor = go_id), by = "go_ancestor") %>% 
  rename(term_ancestor = term)

#GO ids to terms
go_bp = AnnotationDbi::select(GO.db, columns=c("GOID","TERM"), keys="BP", keytype="ONTOLOGY") %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(go_id = goid) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-ontology) %>% 
  right_join(entrez_geneontology, by = "go_id") %>% 
  right_join(symbols_entrez, by = "gene_id") %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  left_join(go_bp_ancestor, by = "go_id") %>% 
  distinct()

#GO immune process

mm_immunego_go.bp = go_bp %>% 
  filter(term_ancestor == "immune system process") %>% 
  rename(go_dataset = term_ancestor,
         process = term,
         genes = symbol) %>% 
  mutate(process = toupper(process),
         immune_set = "Mouse_ImmuneGO")


```

Annotation

There are 943 processes retrieved, but only 18 are directly annotated using Human ImmuneGO. Most general immunological processes are in, like innate immune response,immune response, adaptive immune response, and others.
```{r}
#Merge annotations with Human ImmuneGO

ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genesets_specific = read_csv(here("VaxGO", "ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genesets_specific.csv"))

ImmuneGO_Annotated_GO_specific_original <- read_csv(here("VaxGO", "ImmuneGO_Annotated_GO_specific_originalGOs.csv"))

## There are 943 processes
mm_immunego_annotation = mm_immunego_go.bp %>% 
  select(process, genes, immune_set) %>% 
  group_by(process) %>% 
  summarize(set_size = n(),
            genes,
            immune_set) %>% 
  summarize(genes = paste0(genes, collapse = ","),
            set_size,
            genes,
            immune_set) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  ungroup()  %>% 
  left_join(ImmuneGO_Annotated_GO_specific_original %>% 
              mutate(process_human = str_to_upper(process)) %>% 
              select(process_go_human = process_go, process_human = process, go_term_human = go_term, immune_system:cells),
                by = join_by("process" == "process_go_human"))
#Save
mm_immunego_annotation %>% 
  saveRDS(here("VaxGO", "mm_immunego_annotation.rds"))
mm_immunego_annotation %>% 
  write_excel_csv(here("VaxGO", "mm_immunego_annotation.csv"))
```



### Stats
There are only 18 immune processes matched by name, and 925 unmatched.
```{r}

#How many are not in?
## 925
mm_immunego_annotation %>% 
  filter(is.na(immune_system)) 

## 18 are in
mm_immunego_annotation %>% 
  filter(!is.na(immune_system)) %>% 
  arrange(-set_size)
mm_immunego_annotation %>% 
  filter(!is.na(immune_system)) %>% 
  tabyl(immune_system) %>% 
  janitor::adorn_pct_formatting()



```



Annotate by merging genes with the same symbol (using upper case) by specific processes
There are 2,224 genes not annotated in ImmuneGO human

```{r}
mm_immunego_annotation_genes = mm_immunego_annotation %>% 
  separate_rows(genes, sep = ",") %>% 
  mutate(genes_upper = str_to_upper(genes))

ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genesets_specific_genes = ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genesets_specific %>% 
              mutate(process = str_to_upper(process)) %>% 
              filter(immune_set == "ImmuneGO by Modules") %>% 
              select(process, genes) %>% 
  separate_rows(genes, sep = ",")

BTM_grouped_genesets_specific_genes = ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genesets_specific %>% 
              mutate(process = str_to_upper(process)) %>% 
              filter(immune_set == "BTM by Modules") %>% 
              select(process, genes) %>% 
  separate_rows(genes, sep = ",")

#ImmuneGO human
mm_immunego_annotation_genes_human = mm_immunego_annotation_genes %>% 
  select(genes = genes_upper) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  left_join(ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genesets_specific_genes,
            by = "genes")

#There are 2,224 genes not annotated in ImmuneGO human
mm_immunego_annotation_genes_human %>% 
  filter(is.na(process))

#BTM modules
mm_btm_annotation_genes_human = mm_immunego_annotation_genes %>% 
  select(genes = genes_upper) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  left_join(BTM_grouped_genesets_specific_genes,
            by = "genes")


#There are 2,450 genes not annotated in BTM human
mm_btm_annotation_genes_human %>% 
  filter(is.na(process))
```

By general processes, there are 1,940 genes that were not annotated in both BTM and ImmuneGO
```{r}
ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genesets <- read_csv("VaxGO/ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genesets.csv")
ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes = ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genesets %>% 
  separate_rows(genes) %>% 
  select(process, genes) %>% distinct()

#ImmuneGO and BTM modules
mm_ImmuneGO_BTM_annotation_genes_human = mm_immunego_annotation_genes %>% 
  select(genes = genes_upper) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  left_join(ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes,
```



#### Approach 1

```{r}
library(readxl)
ImmuneGO_Mouse_Manual <- read_excel(here("VaxGO", "ImmuneGO_Mouse.xlsx"))
```

#### Approach 2
By percentage: The gene sets were merged exclusively by genes that were in both gene sets. The percentage was calculated by the frequency of each process in human ImmuneGO divided by the mouse set_size.
```{r}
mm_immunego_annotation_genes_match = mm_immunego_annotation_genes %>% 
  select(process_mice = process, genes_mice = genes_upper, set_size) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  inner_join(ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genesets %>%
            filter(immune_set %in% c("ImmuneGO", "ImmuneGO by Modules")) %>% 
              separate_rows(genes) %>% 
              select(process, genes, immune_system:cells,
                     immune_set,
                     set_size_human = set_size) %>% 
              rename(process_human = process, 
                     genes_human = genes) %>% 
              mutate(immune_system = if_else(is.na(immune_system), "Manual annotation", immune_system),
                     immune_subsystem = if_else(is.na(immune_subsystem), "Manual annotation", immune_subsystem),
                     cells = if_else(is.na(cells), "Manual annotation", cells)),
            by = join_by("genes_mice" == "genes_human")) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  group_by(process_mice, process_human) %>% 
  arrange(process_mice, process_human) %>% 
  summarize(set_size_mice = set_size,
            set_size_human, 
            match_human = n(),
            match_perc = match_human/set_size*100,
            immune_system,
            immune_subsystem,
            cells,
            immune_set) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(process_mice) %>% 
  arrange(-match_human, -match_perc) %>% 
  ungroup()
mm_immunego_annotation_genes_match
```

```{r}
            by = join_by("process_mice" == "process_go_human"))
```

```{r}
  dplyr::select(process:go_term, set_size:genes) %>% 
  distinct()

ImmuneGO_Annotated_Genes = ImmuneGO_Annotated_GO %>% 
   separate_rows(genes, sep = ",")

# Separate TCR and BCR repertoire genes
TCR_BCR_repertoire = ImmuneGO_Annotated_Genes %>% 
  filter(grepl("^TR", genes) & process == "ADAPTIVE IMMUNE SYSTEM" |
           grepl("^IG", genes) & process == "ADAPTIVE IMMUNE SYSTEM" |
           grepl("^TR", genes) & process == "CELLULAR ADAPTIVE IMMUNE SYSTEM" |
         grepl("^IG", genes) & process == "HUMORAL ADAPTIVE IMMUNE SYSTEM") %>% 
  mutate(process = if_else(process == "CELLULAR ADAPTIVE IMMUNE SYSTEM", "TCR REPERTOIRE", 
                           "BCR REPERTOIRE"),
         gene_set_short = if_else(process == "TCR REPERTOIRE", 
                                  "TCR REPERTOIRE", 
                           "BCR REPERTOIRE"),
         process = if_else(grepl("^TR", genes), "TCR REPERTOIRE", "BCR REPERTOIRE"),
         immune_sub_system = if_else(process == "TCR REPERTOIRE", "Cellular", "Humoral"),
         immune_tissue = if_else(process == "TCR REPERTOIRE", "Cellular", "Humoral"))

immunego_manual = ImmuneGO_Annotated_Genes %>%
  filter(go_term == "Manual") %>% 
  anti_join(TCR_BCR_repertoire %>% dplyr::select(genes) %>% distinct(), by = "genes") %>% 
  bind_rows()

#Verify if all genes are annotated. If there are no left genes, you are good to go
a = ImmuneGO_Annotated_Genes %>% filter(go_term == "Manual") %>% dplyr::select(genes) %>% distinct()
ImmuneGO_Annotated_Genes %>% dplyr::select(process, genes, immune_system) %>% anti_join(a, by = "genes")


#Salvar
write.csv(ImmuneGO_Annotated_GO, file = paste0("ImmuneGO_Annotated_GO_", today(), ".csv"), row.names = F)
saveRDS(ImmuneGO_Annotated_GO, file = paste0("ImmuneGO_Annotated_GO_", today(), ".rds"))
saveRDS(ImmuneGO_Annotated_Genes, file = paste0("ImmuneGO_Annotated_Genes_", today(), ".rds"))

#Display
view(ImmuneGO_Annotated_GO)
view(ImmuneGO_Annotated_Genes)
```

```{r}
#By cell

                              process == "INNATE" ~ "INNATE IMMUNE SYSTEM",
                              process == "INTERFERON" ~ "ANTIVIRAL & IFN",
                              process == "NK" ~ "NK CELL",
                              process == "B CELL, PLASMA CELL" ~ "B CELL",
                              process == "PLASMA CELL" ~ "B CELL",
                              process == "PRR" ~ "ARPP",
                              process == "SIGNALING" ~ "SIGNALING",
                              process == "TH2" ~ "T CELL",

                              process == "T HELPER CELLS" ~ "T CELL",

                              )) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  bind_rows(
    immunego_btm_specific_grouped)

immunego_btm_manual_grouped_genes = immunego_btm_manual_grouped %>%
```

```{r}
                 "ensembl_gene_id",
                 "entrezgene_id",

```

## Filter genes with highest median expression

- 39,430 probes in the microarray,
- 39,392 that were annotated in BiomaRt (~99.90%)
- 37,983 probes had a correspondent mgi symbol (96.33% of probes in microarray)
- 31,140 probes had a correspondent entrez id (78.97% of probes in microarray)
- 30,787 probes with entrez id also had a correspondent mgi_symbol (78.08% of probes in microarray)
- 22,435 probes have an entrez gene id. As this is the input in FIT, we used this to filter, not mgi_symbol (56.89% of probes in microarray)
- 21,744 genes were filtered by the highest median (55.14% were kept from the microarray)
- 86 Dupes. The duplication is due to different mgi_symbols. Same Entrez IDs can correspond to different mgi_symbol
- 20849 probes were used (52.87%)

```{r}

#Get annotations for each probe 

GSE120661_counts_normalized_summary = GSE120661_counts_normalized_matrix %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("probe") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -probe,
               names_to = "sample",
               values_to = "expression") %>% 
  group_by(probe) %>% 
  summarize(mean = mean(expression,na.rm = TRUE),
            median = median(expression, na.rm = T)) %>%  
  inner_join(annot %>% 
              rename(probe = agilent_sureprint_g3_ge_8x60k), 
            by = "probe") 

# Stats
## 39430 probes in the microarray
GSE120661_counts_normalized_matrix %>% dim()
## 37,983 probes with mgi_symbol
GSE120661_counts_normalized_summary %>% 
  drop_na(mgi_symbol) %>% 
  filter(mgi_symbol != "")
## 31,140 probes with Entrez gene id
GSE120661_counts_normalized_summary %>% 
  drop_na(entrezgene_id)
## 30,787 of these probes with mgi_symbol also had a correspondent entrez gene id
GSE120661_counts_normalized_summary %>% 
  drop_na(mgi_symbol) %>% 
  filter(mgi_symbol != "") %>% 
  drop_na(entrezgene_id)
## 30,787 probes with entrez id also had a correspondent mgi_symbol
GSE120661_counts_normalized_summary %>% 
  drop_na(entrezgene_id) %>% 
  filter(mgi_symbol != "") 

#Get the probes with the highest median across samples for each entrez_id
GSE120661_expression_highest_median_probes = GSE120661_counts_normalized_summary %>% 
  drop_na(entrezgene_id) %>% 
  group_by(entrezgene_id) %>% 
  slice_max(median) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  arrange(entrezgene_id, probe)  %>% 
  select(probe, entrezgene_id, mgi_symbol, median) %>% 
  distinct()

#86 Dupes. The duplication is due to different mgi_symbols. Same Entrez IDs can correspond to different mgi_symbol
GSE120661_expression_highest_median_probes %>% 
  get_dupes(entrezgene_id)

#Modify expression matrix
GSE120661_counts_normalized_matrix = GSE120661_counts_normalized_matrix %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("probe") %>% 
  filter(probe %in% c(GSE120661_expression_highest_median_probes$probe)) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("probe") %>% 
  as.matrix()

GSE120661_counts_normalized_matrix %>% dim()

```



##Differential gene expression
```{r}
dim(GSE120661_counts_normalized_matrix) #20849   279

dim(AnnotatedDataFrame(GSE120661_samples_pbmc %>% column_to_rownames("geo_sample"))) #279
    
eset_filtered <- ExpressionSet(
  assayData = GSE120661_counts_normalized_matrix ,
  phenoData = AnnotatedDataFrame(GSE120661_samples_pbmc %>% column_to_rownames("geo_sample"))
)


design <- model.matrix(~ timepoint * treatment + 0, eset_filtered) # 0 defines the way we compare the samples
colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))  # Avoids blank spaces

#Fit Limma model
fit <- lmFit(eset_filtered, design)
colnames(design) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  arrange(.)
```

```{r}
#Test for Fluad
cont.matrix <- makeContrasts(timepoint4.treatmentFluad - treatmentFluad,
                             timepoint8.treatmentFluad - treatmentFluad,
                             timepoint24.treatmentFluad - treatmentFluad,
                             timepoint48.treatmentFluad - treatmentFluad,
                             timepoint72.treatmentFluad - treatmentFluad,
                             timepoint168.treatmentFluad - treatmentFluad,
                             levels=design)

fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, cont.matrix)
fit2 <- treat(fit2, lfc = 0.0)

#Get DEGs
## For one contrast (example)
# all_degs = topTreat(fit2, coef = 1, adjust = "fdr", p.value = 1, number = Inf, confint = TRUE)

## For every contrast
results_list <- lapply(1:ncol(fit2), function(i) {
  topTreat(fit2, coef = i, adjust = "fdr", p.value = 1, number = Inf, confint = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(comparison = colnames(fit2)[i]) %>% 
    rownames_to_column("probe")
    
})

# Combine all results
all_contrasts_degs <- bind_rows(results_list)

# Get all DEGs
all_degs = all_contrasts_degs %>% 
  select(comparison, everything()) %>% 
  mutate(comparison = str_replace(comparison, "\\.\\.\\.", "_") %>% 
           str_replace(., "timepoint", "Time") %>% 
           str_replace(., "treatment", "")) %>% 
  separate(comparison, sep = " - ", into = c("comparisonA", "comparisonRef")) %>% 
  mutate(comparisonRef = str_replace(comparisonRef, "treatment", "Time0")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = case_when(comparisonA == "Time4.Fluad"	~ "Fluad_4_PBMC",
                               comparisonA == "Time8.Fluad"	~ "Fluad_8_PBMC",
                               comparisonA == "Time24.Fluad"	~ "Fluad_24_PBMC",
                               comparisonA == "Time48.Fluad"	~ "Fluad_48_PBMC",
                               comparisonA == "Time72.Fluad"	~ "Fluad_72_PBMC",
                               comparisonA == "Time168.Fluad"	~ "Fluad_168_PBMC",
                               T~comparisonA)) %>% 
  select(condition, everything())
	
all_degs
```

### Gene annotation
- 27,317 genes in the input matrix
- 25,035 probes from DGE analysis (no lfc threshold)

About FIT genes:
- 16,425 genes in FIT analysis (including human and mouse genes)
- 16,417 unique mouse to human genes (are duplicated)
- 34 genes have either different hgnc symbol to mgi symbol, or the other way.
- 16 human genes are repeated because of different Entrez IDs
- 14,357 mouse genes in FIT are in the limma output. 
- 14,448 unique human genes 
- 223 mouse symbols correspond to the same or another human symbol

###Loops
```{r}

all_degs_fit2 = read_csv(here("tables", "Fluad_PBMC_FIT_mouse_allTimePoints.csv"))

# Generate csv for every condition
all_conditions <- unique(all_degs_fit2$condition)
purrr::walk(all_conditions, function(cond) {
  
  delete_dupes <- all_degs_fit2 %>%
    filter(condition == cond) %>%
    get_dupes(row) %>%
    pull(row)
  
  filtered_df <- all_degs_fit2 %>%
    filter(condition == cond, !row %in% delete_dupes) %>%
    select(-condition) %>% 
    column_to_rownames("row")
  
  file_name <- paste0(cond, "_FIT_mouse.csv")
  file_path <- here("tables", file_name)
  
  write_csv(filtered_df, file_path)
})

```
## Loop FIT for every timepoint
Obs: Make sure that datasets from FIT package were retrieved

Initial number of genes: 15503
Number of genes for which FIT predictions will be calculated: 14401

```{r}
#Import files
pca_rotations = FIT.mouse2man::pca_rotations
best_models = FIT.mouse2man::best_models
HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez = FIT.mouse2man::HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez
MM_Entrez_symbol_desc = FIT.mouse2man::MM_Entrez_symbol_desc
Psoriasis_classifier_neg = FIT.mouse2man::Psoriasis_classifier_neg
slopes_per_gene_V2.0 = FIT.mouse2man::slopes_per_gene_V2.0
StaphInfection_classifier_pos = FIT.mouse2man::StaphInfection_classifier_pos
AllData_V2.0 = FIT.mouse2man::AllData_V2.0 #Training data


# FIT loop
fit_results_combined <- map2_dfr(all_conditions, all_conditions, function(cond, cond_name) {
  
  # 1. Monta o caminho do CSV
  file_path <- here("tables", paste0(cond, "_FIT_mouse.csv"))
  
  # 2. Roda o FIT
  fit_output <- FIT.mouse2man::FIT(MouseFile = file_path, DataType = "rnaseq")
  
  # 3. Converte para tibble e adiciona a coluna da condição
  fit_output_tbl <- as_tibble(fit_output) %>%
    mutate(condition = cond_name)
  
  return(fit_output_tbl)
})

fit_results_combined

fit_results_combined %>% saveRDS(here("FIT_Mouse2man", "FIT_FLUAD_alltimes.csv"))
```

## Compare with human log2fc
```{r}
cleandata_nonorm_flu <- readRDS(here("HumanFluData", "cleandata_nonorm_flu.rds")) 

flu_expFC <- readRDS(here("HumanFluData", "expFC.rds"))
flu_expression_fc = flu_expFC[["exp_fc"]] %>% 
  as.data.frame()

flu_metadata = flu_expFC$cur_phenoData

flu_expression_fc_long = flu_expression_fc %>%
  rownames_to_column("genes") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -genes,
               names_to = "uid",
               values_to = "fold_change") 

flu_metadata %>% 
  select(study_time_collected) %>%
  group_by(study_time_collected) %>% 
  summarize(n = n())

flu_expression_fc_long_metadata = flu_expression_fc_long %>% 
  inner_join(flu_metadata, by = "uid") 

flu_expression_fc_summary = flu_expression_fc_long_metadata %>% 
  mutate(l2fc = sign(fold_change) * log2(abs(fold_change))) %>% 
  group_by(genes, exposure_material_reported, adjuvant, study_time_collected) %>% 
    summarize(mean = mean(l2fc, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(l2fc, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    lower = mean - 1.96 * se,
    upper = mean + 1.96 * se,
    study_time_collected,
    vaccine_type,
    adjuvant) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  distinct()

flu_expression_fc_summary

flu_expression_fc_summary %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", "flu_expression_fc_summary_human.rds"))
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
pairwise_human_fit_measures = meta_human %>% 
  inner_join(meta_fit, by = join_by(human_symbol, timepoint)) %>% 
  inner_join(meta_mouse, by = join_by(human_symbol, timepoint)) %>% 
  inner_join(pairwise_human_fit, by = join_by(human_symbol, timepoint)) %>% 
    mutate(ci_width_mouse = ci_high_mouse - ci_low_mouse,
          ci_width_fit = ci_high_fit - ci_low_fit,
          ci_width_human = ci_high_human - ci_low_human) %>% 
  mutate(
        # Estimate SE from CIs
    se_fit = (ci_high_fit - ci_low_fit) / (2 * 1.96),
    se_mouse = (ci_high_mouse - ci_low_mouse) / (2 * 1.96),
    z_fit = mean_fit / se_fit,
    z_mouse = mean_mouse / se_mouse,
    pval_fit = 2 * pnorm(-abs(z_fit)),
    pval_mouse = 2 * pnorm(-abs(z_mouse)),
    pval_fit_adj = p.adjust(pval_fit, method = "BH"),
    pval_mouse_adj = p.adjust(pval_mouse, method = "BH"),)
```

# Regression model: Regression metrics

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
pairwise_human_fit_measures = readRDS(here("FIT_Mouse2man", "pairwise_human_fit_measures.rds"))

pairwise_human_fit_test = pairwise_human_fit_measures %>%
  mutate(
    # Estimate SE from CIs
    se_fit = (ci_high_fit - ci_low_fit) / (2 * 1.96),
    se_mouse = (ci_high_mouse - ci_low_mouse) / (2 * 1.96),
    
    # Combine SE
    se_diff_human_fit = sqrt(se_human^2 + se_fit^2),
    se_diff_human_mouse = sqrt(se_human^2 + se_mouse^2),
    
    # Z score
    z_score_human_fit = human_2_fit / se_diff_human_fit,
    z_score_human_mouse = human_2_mouse / se_diff_human_mouse,
    
    # p-value
    p_value_fit = 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z_score_human_fit))),
    p_value_mouse = 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z_score_human_mouse))),
    
    # FDR (Benjamini-Hochberg)
    p_value_fit_adj = p.adjust(p_value_fit, method = "BH"),
    p_value_mouse_adj = p.adjust(p_value_mouse, method = "BH"),
    
    # Cohen's d
    effect_size_h2fit = human_2_fit / se_diff_human_fit,
    effect_size_h2m = human_2_mouse / se_diff_human_mouse
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_value_fit)
```

```{r}
               values_to = "l2fc",
               names_to = "organism") %>% 
  rename(diff_h2m = human_2_mouse,
         diff_h2fit = human_2_fit,
         se_diff_h2fit = se_diff_human_fit,
         se_diff_h2m = se_diff_human_mouse,
         z_score_h2fit = z_score_human_fit,
         z_score_h2m = z_score_human_mouse) %>% 
  mutate(organism = if_else(organism == "FIT Prediction", "FIT", organism)) %>% 
  
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(human_symbol, timepoint, organism),
               values_to = "value",
               names_to = "metric") %>% 
  mutate(
    organism = case_when(
      str_detect(metric, "human") ~ "Human",
      str_detect(metric, "fit") ~ "FIT",
      str_detect(metric, "mouse") ~ "Mouse",
      metric == "Human" ~ "Human",
      metric == "FIT Prediction" ~ "FIT",
      TRUE ~ organism),
    metric = str_remove_all(metric, "_?(human|mouse|fit)$"),
    metric = str_remove_all(metric, "_?(human|mouse|fit)")
  ) %>% 
  mutate(organism = case_when(str_detect(metric, "h2m") ~ "Mouse",
```

## Compute overall metrics 
Import

### All genes

#### Calculate metrics
```{r}

library(yardstick)
#FIT
filter_conditions_fit <- expand_grid(
  padj_fit = c(0.01, 0.05, seq(0.1, 1, by = 0.1)),
  expr_cutoff = c(0.01, seq(0.05, 0.5, by = 0.05), 0.75, 1),
  ci_percentile = c(0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 1.0),
  timepoint = c(1, 3, 7)
)

filter_conditions_results_fit_degs <- filter_conditions_fit %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  do({
    fc <- .
    
    # Filtrar apenas dados do timepoint atual
    data_timepoint <- pairwise_human_fit_test %>%
      filter(timepoint == fc$timepoint)

    # Calcular o cutoff do percentil escolhido
    ci_cutoff <- quantile(data_timepoint$ci_width_fit, probs = fc$ci_percentile, na.rm = TRUE)

    # Aplicar filtros
    filtered_data <- data_timepoint %>%
      filter(
        pval_fit_adj < fc$padj_fit,
        abs(`FIT Prediction`) > fc$expr_cutoff,
        ci_width_fit <= ci_cutoff
      )

    if (nrow(filtered_data) >= 2) {
      metrics <- filtered_data %>%
        summarise(
          n_genes = n(),
          RMSE = rmse_vec(Human, `FIT Prediction`),
          MAE = mae_vec(Human, `FIT Prediction`),
          R2 = rsq_vec(Human, `FIT Prediction`),
          Spearman = cor(Human, `FIT Prediction`, method = "spearman"),
          Pearson = cor(Human, `FIT Prediction`, method = "pearson")
        )
    } else {
      metrics <- tibble(
        n_genes = 0,
        RMSE = NA, MAE = NA, R2 = NA,
        Spearman = NA, Pearson = NA
      )
    }

    bind_cols(fc, tibble(ci_width_cutoff = ci_cutoff), metrics)
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(organism = "FIT") %>%
  rename(padj_cutoff = padj_fit) %>% 
  mutate(ci_percentile = paste0(ci_percentile * 100, "%"))

  arrange(MAE)
filter_conditions_results_fit_degs %>% 
  arrange(-R2)
filter_conditions_results_fit_degs %>% 
  arrange(-Spearman)
filter_conditions_results_fit_degs %>% 
  arrange(-Pearson)
```

### Immune genes

Import
```{r}
ImmuneGO_Mouse_Manual <- read_excel(here("VaxGO", "ImmuneGO_Mouse.xlsx"))

ImmuneGO_Mouse_Manual_genes = ImmuneGO_Mouse_Manual %>% 
  separate_rows(genes)

library(yardstick)
```
#### Calculate metrics
```{r}
immune_genes <- unique(ImmuneGO_Mouse_Manual_genes$genes) %>% str_to_upper()

#FIT
filter_conditions_fit <- expand_grid(
  padj_fit = c(0.01, 0.05, seq(0.1, 1, by = 0.1)),
  expr_cutoff = c(0.01, seq(0.05, 0.5, by = 0.05), 0.75, 1),
  ci_percentile = c(0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 1.0),
  timepoint = c(1, 3, 7)
)

filter_conditions_results_fit_degs_immune <- filter_conditions_fit %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  do({
    fc <- .
    
    # Filtrar apenas dados do timepoint atual
    data_timepoint <- pairwise_human_fit_test %>%
      filter(human_symbol %in% c(immune_genes)) %>% 
      filter(timepoint == fc$timepoint)

    # Calcular o cutoff do percentil escolhido
    ci_cutoff <- quantile(data_timepoint$ci_width_fit, probs = fc$ci_percentile, na.rm = TRUE)

    # Aplicar filtros
    filtered_data <- data_timepoint %>%
      filter(
        pval_fit_adj < fc$padj_fit,
        abs(`FIT Prediction`) > fc$expr_cutoff,
        ci_width_fit <= ci_cutoff
      )

    if (nrow(filtered_data) >= 2) {
      metrics <- filtered_data %>%
        summarise(
          n_genes = n(),
          RMSE = rmse_vec(Human, `FIT Prediction`),
          MAE = mae_vec(Human, `FIT Prediction`),
          R2 = rsq_vec(Human, `FIT Prediction`),
          Spearman = cor(Human, `FIT Prediction`, method = "spearman"),
          Pearson = cor(Human, `FIT Prediction`, method = "pearson")
        )
    } else {
      metrics <- tibble(
        n_genes = 0,
        RMSE = NA, MAE = NA, R2 = NA,
        Spearman = NA, Pearson = NA
      )
    }

    bind_cols(fc, tibble(ci_width_cutoff = ci_cutoff), metrics)
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(organism = "FIT_Immune") %>%
  rename(padj_cutoff = padj_fit) %>% 
  mutate(ci_percentile = paste0(ci_percentile * 100, "%"))
```

#### Plot correlation

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)

# Lista de genes imunes
immune_genes <- unique(ImmuneGO_Mouse_Manual_genes$genes) %>% str_to_upper()

# Parâmetros
padj_values <- c(0.01, 0.05, seq(0.1, 1, 0.1))
ci_percentiles <- c(0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5)
logfc_cutoffs <- c(0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1)
timepoints <- c(1, 3, 7)

# Expandir e aplicar filtros com tipo seguro
plot_data_lfc <- expand.grid(
  padj_fit = padj_values,
  ci_percentile = ci_percentiles,
  expr_cutoff = logfc_cutoffs,
  timepoint = timepoints
) %>%
  pmap_dfr(function(padj_fit, ci_percentile, expr_cutoff, timepoint) {
    
    df <- pairwise_human_fit_test %>%
      filter(timepoint == !!timepoint)
    
    ci_cutoff <- quantile(df$ci_width_mouse, probs = ci_percentile, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    df_filtered <- df %>%
      filter(
        pval_mouse_adj < padj_fit,
        abs(Mouse) > expr_cutoff,
        ci_width_mouse <= ci_cutoff
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        padj_fit = paste0("padj < ", padj_fit),
        ci_percentile = paste0("CI ", ci_percentile * 100, "%"),
        expr_cutoff = paste0("log2FC > ", expr_cutoff),
        immune_status = ifelse(str_to_upper(human_symbol) %in% immune_genes, "Immune", "Non-Immune"),
        timepoint = timepoint
      )
    
    if (nrow(df_filtered) == 0) {
      return(tibble(
        padj_fit = character(),
        ci_percentile = character(),
        expr_cutoff = character(),
        immune_status = character(),
        timepoint = numeric()
      ))
    } else {
      return(df_filtered)
    }
  })
```

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=6}
human_vs_mouse_immune = pairwise_human_fit_test %>% 
  mutate(immune_status = ifelse(str_to_upper(human_symbol) %in% immune_genes, "Immune", "Non-Immune")) %>% 
mutate(pval_cuts = case_when(
  pval_mouse_adj <= 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
  pval_mouse_adj <= 0.01 ~ "<0.01",
  pval_mouse_adj <= 0.05 ~ "<0.05",
  pval_mouse_adj <= 0.10 ~ "<0.10",
  pval_mouse_adj <= 0.25 ~ "<0.25",
  TRUE ~ ">0.25"
)) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = Mouse,
      y = Human,
      color = immune_status,
      fill = immune_status) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2,
             size = 0.2,
             # fill = NA,
             pch = 21,
             show.legend = F,
             # color = "#90A4AEFF"
             ) +
  geom_smooth(method = 'lm', se = TRUE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Immune"  = "#CE1800FF",
    "Non-Immune" = "#90A4AEFF"
  )) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Immune"  = "#CE1800FF",
    "Non-Immune" = "#90A4AEFF"
  )) +

  facet_grid(~timepoint~pval_cuts, scales = "free_x") +
    scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 4) +
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 4) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  labs(title ="Mouse vs Human gene expression") +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, angle = 0),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(1, "lines"),
  )

fit_vs_human_immune = pairwise_human_fit_test %>%

mutate(pval_cuts = case_when(
```

# Classification model

```{r}
#Define cutoffs
padj_cutoffs <- c(0.05, 0.10, 0.20, 0.30, 0.40, 0.50)
l2fc_cutoffs <- c(0, 0.1, 0.5, 1)

# Grid 
cutoff_grid <- expand_grid(padj_cutoff = padj_cutoffs, l2fc_cutoff = l2fc_cutoffs)

# Get DEGs
base_df <- pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide %>%
  filter()
  select(human_symbol:ci_high, ci_width) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(
    z_deg = mean / se,
    p_deg = 2 * pnorm(-abs(z_deg)),
    padj_deg = p.adjust(p_deg, method = "BH")
  )

# Apply function
classified_df <- pmap_dfr(
  cutoff_grid,
  function(padj_cutoff, l2fc_cutoff) {
    base_df %>%
      mutate(
        padj_cutoff = padj_cutoff,
        l2fc_cutoff = l2fc_cutoff,
        classification = case_when(
          padj_deg < padj_cutoff & mean > l2fc_cutoff  ~ "up",
          padj_deg < padj_cutoff & mean < -l2fc_cutoff ~ "down",
          TRUE                                          ~ "neutral"
        )
      )
  })


classified_df %>% 
  saveRDS(here("FIT_Mouse2man", "genes_l2fc_fit_mouse_human_classified_cutoffs.rds"))
```


```{r}

classified_df = read_rds(here("FIT_Mouse2man", "genes_l2fc_fit_mouse_human_classified_cutoffs.rds"))

         padj_deg < 0.10) %>% 
  pull(human_symbol) %>% 
  unique()

length(degs_human)

#Summarize genes
classified_df_countgenes_degs_direction = classified_df %>% 
  filter(human_symbol %in% c(degs_human)) %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, padj_cutoff, l2fc_cutoff, classification) %>% 
  summarize(n_genes = n()) %>% 
  ungroup()  %>% 
  mutate(across(c(timepoint, padj_cutoff, l2fc_cutoff), as.character))
```

```{r}
# Define o conjunto de métricas corretamente
my_metrics <- metric_set(accuracy, precision, recall, f_meas, spec, sens)

### FIT
# "up" vs all
acc_up_vs_all_fit <- classified_eval %>%
  mutate(
    truth = factor(ifelse(Human == "up", "up", "not_up"), levels = c("up", "not_up")),
    estimate = factor(ifelse(FIT == "up", "up", "not_up"), levels = c("up", "not_up"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(timepoint, padj_cutoff, l2fc_cutoff) %>%
  my_metrics(truth = truth, estimate = estimate) %>%
  mutate(model = "FIT", target = "up")

acc_up_vs_all_fit30 <- classified_eval %>%
  drop_na() %>% 
  mutate(
    truth = factor(ifelse(Human == "up", "up", "not_up"), levels = c("up", "not_up")),
    estimate = factor(ifelse(`FIT (CI 30%)` == "up", "up", "not_up"), levels = c("up", "not_up"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(timepoint, padj_cutoff, l2fc_cutoff) %>%
  my_metrics(truth = truth, estimate = estimate) %>%
  mutate(model = "FIT 30%", target = "up")

# "down" vs all
acc_down_vs_all_fit <- classified_eval %>%
  mutate(
    truth = factor(ifelse(Human == "down", "down", "not_down"), levels = c("down", "not_down")),
    estimate = factor(ifelse(FIT == "down", "down", "not_down"), levels = c("down", "not_down"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(timepoint, padj_cutoff, l2fc_cutoff) %>%
  my_metrics(truth = truth, estimate = estimate) %>%
  mutate(model = "FIT", target = "down")

acc_down_vs_all_fit30 <- classified_eval %>%
  mutate(
    truth = factor(ifelse(Human == "down", "down", "not_down"), levels = c("down", "not_down")),
    estimate = factor(ifelse(`FIT (CI 30%)` == "down", "down", "not_down"), levels = c("down", "not_down"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(timepoint, padj_cutoff, l2fc_cutoff) %>%
  my_metrics(truth = truth, estimate = estimate) %>%
  mutate(model = "FIT 30%", target = "down")

acc_fit_results <- bind_rows(acc_up_vs_all_fit, acc_up_vs_all_fit30, acc_down_vs_all_fit, acc_down_vs_all_fit30)

fit_classification_degs_ngenes <- classified_eval %>%
  mutate(
    truth = factor(Human, levels = c("up", "down", "neutral")),
    estimate = factor(FIT, levels = c("up", "down", "neutral")),
    correct = truth == estimate,
    incorrect = truth != estimate
  ) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint, padj_cutoff, l2fc_cutoff, truth) %>%
  summarise(
    num_correct_tp = sum(correct, na.rm = T),
    num_incorrect_fp = sum(incorrect, na.rm = T),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(model = "FIT")

fit_classification_degs_ngenes_ci30 <- classified_eval %>%
  mutate(
    truth = factor(Human, levels = c("up", "down", "neutral")),
    estimate = factor(`FIT (CI 30%)`, levels = c("up", "down", "neutral")),
    correct = truth == estimate,
    incorrect = truth != estimate
  ) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint, padj_cutoff, l2fc_cutoff, truth) %>%
  summarise(
    num_correct_tp = sum(correct, na.rm = T),
    num_incorrect_fp = sum(incorrect, na.rm = T),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(model = "FIT 30%")

fit_classification_degs_ngenes = bind_rows(fit_classification_degs_ngenes, fit_classification_degs_ngenes_ci30)

fit_classification_degs = acc_fit_results %>% 
  rename(truth = target) %>% 
  inner_join(fit_classification_degs_ngenes,
             by = join_by("model", "timepoint", "padj_cutoff", "l2fc_cutoff", "truth"))

fit_classification_degs %>% 
  arrange(-.estimate) %>% 
  filter(num_correct_tp > 0)
```

## Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA)

Function

```{r}

autoGSEA <- function(df, TERM2GENE, geneset_name) {
  gsea_results <- list()

  conditions <- df$condition %>%
    unique() %>%
    as.character()

  for (condition_i in conditions) {
    
    degs_condition <- df %>%
      filter(condition == condition_i) %>%
      dplyr::select(genes, log2fold_change) %>%
      distinct() %>%
      # mutate(rank = rank(log2fold_change, ties.method = "random")) %>%
      arrange(desc(log2fold_change)) %>% 
      deframe()

    auto_gsea <- tryCatch({
      GSEA(geneList = degs_condition,
           TERM2GENE = TERM2GENE,
           minGSSize = 1,
           maxGSSize = 1000,
           pvalueCutoff = 1,
           pAdjustMethod = "BH") %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        arrange(qvalue) %>%
        mutate(condition = condition_i,
               gsea_enrichment = geneset_name)
    }, error = function(e) {
      return(NULL)
    })

    if (!is.null(auto_gsea)) {
      key <- paste(condition_i, geneset_name, sep = "_")
      gsea_results[[key]] <- auto_gsea
    }
  }

  return(list(
    gsea = bind_rows(gsea_results)
  ))
}

dge_long_genes df$condition %>%
```

#### Heatmap (Mouse immune processes)

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=20}
# Function for clustering by day
cluster_by_day <- function(df, day_column = "day", condition_column = "condition") {
  
  # Obter os níveis do fator da coluna de dias
  days <- levels(df[[day_column]])
  
  # Inicializar uma lista para armazenar as ordens
  orders <- list()
  
  # Loop por cada nível (dia) da coluna fator day
  for (day_value in days) {
    # Filtrar os dados para o dia atual
    day_data <- df %>%
      filter(!!sym(day_column) == day_value) %>%
      dplyr::select(!!sym(condition_column)) %>%
      distinct()
    
    # Criar uma matriz binária onde 1 representa a presença da condição
    if (nrow(day_data) > 1) {
      # Matriz com condições como rótulos e 1 para presença
      presence_matrix <- table(day_data[[condition_column]]) > 0
      dist_matrix <- as.matrix(presence_matrix)
      
      # Aplicar o clustering
      col_clustered <- dist(dist_matrix) %>% hclust()
      
      # Armazenar a ordem dos clusters
      orders[[day_value]] <- col_clustered$labels[col_clustered$order]
    } else {
      # Se houver apenas uma condição, armazenar o rótulo
      orders[[day_value]] <- as.character(day_data[[condition_column]])
    }
  }
  
  # Converter a lista de ordens para um data frame
  order_df <- data.frame(
    day = rep(names(orders), sapply(orders, length)),
    condition = unlist(orders)
  )
  
  return(order_df)
}

```

```{r fig.height=15, fig.width=12}
library(ggdendro)
library(cowplot)

df =  gsea_results_immuneGO_Manual %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  select(condition, id = description, p_adjust, nes) %>% 
  separate(condition,into = c("model", "day"), remove = F) %>% 
  mutate(day = str_remove(day, "Day"),
         day = day %>% fct_relevel(day, "0", "1", "3", "7")) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("del") %>% 
  select(-del)


df_p10 = df %>% 
  filter(p_adjust<= 0.10) %>%
  mutate(logq = -log10(p_adjust))


df_neg = df %>% 
  filter(p_adjust<= 0.50) %>%
  filter(nes < 0) %>% 
  mutate(logq = -log10(p_adjust))

df = bind_rows(df_p10,
            df_neg)


row_clustered = df %>% 
  dplyr::select(condition, id, nes) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
              values_from= "nes") %>%
  column_to_rownames("id") %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  replace(is.na(.), 0) %>% 
  dist(.) %>% 
  hclust()

result_vac <- cluster_by_day(df, day_column = "day", condition_column = "condition") %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(day = fct_relevel(day, df$day %>% unique() %>% sort() %>% as.character()))


column_order <- c(result_vac$condition)

labels_day = df %>% 
  filter(id %in% row_clustered$labels) %>% 
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, column_order)) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = condition, y = 1, fill = day) + 
  geom_tile() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "0" = "white",
    "1" = "#caf0f8",
    "3" = "#90e0ef",
    "7" = "#0096c7")) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(y = "Day") +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none")


labels_organism = df %>% 
  filter(id %in% row_clustered$labels) %>% 
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, column_order)) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = condition, y = 1, fill = model) + 
  geom_tile() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Human"  = "#4DBBD5FF",
    "Mouse" = "#90A4AEFF",
    "FIT"   = "#CE1800FF"
  )) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(y = "Organism") +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none")

#Plot
dotplot = df %>% 
  filter(id %in% row_clustered$labels) %>% 
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, column_order),
                  id = fct_relevel(id, c(row_clustered$labels)),
         id = fct_rev(id)) %>% 
    mutate(signific = case_when(p_adjust <= 0.10 ~ "*",
                              p_adjust <= 0.25 ~ "-",
                              p_adjust <= 0.50 ~ "/",
                              p_adjust <= 0.05 ~ "**",
                              TRUE ~ "")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=condition, y = id, fill = nes, size = logq)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white",
            size = 0) + 
  geom_text(aes(label = signific), size = 4, vjust = 0.5, color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 8) ,
        axis.line  = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(x = "",
       y = "") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
  low = "#4DBBD5FF",      # azul para -1
  mid = "white",          # branco para 0
  high = "#DC0000FF",     # vermelho para +1
  midpoint = 0,
  oob = scales::squish,
  limits = c(-1, 2),      # fixa o intervalo
  name = "NES", ) +
  scale_y_discrete(position = "right") +
  scale_size(range = c(2, 6))
  

patch_immune_main = 
  labels_organism/
  labels_day/
  dotplot +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.08, 0.08, 5),

                  theme = theme(legend.position = "bottom",
                                plot.margin = margin(0.5, 0, 0.5, 1, unit = "cm"),
                                legend.direction = "horizontal", 
                                legend.box = "horizontal"))
```

##### Specific processes
```{r fig.height=15, fig.width=8}
library(ggdendro)
library(cowplot)

df =  gsea_results_immuneGO_Manual_human %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(description, "\\(M"),#Filter out BTM IDs
         str_detect(description, "[a-z]")) %>% #Filter out main processes (Upper case)
  select(condition, id = description, p_adjust, nes) %>% 
  separate(condition,into = c("model", "day"), remove = F) %>% 
  mutate(day = str_remove(day, "Day"),
         day = day %>% fct_relevel(day, "0", "1", "3", "7")) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("del") %>% 
  select(-del)


df_p10 = df %>% 
  filter(p_adjust<= 0.10) %>%
  mutate(logq = -log10(p_adjust))


df_neg = df %>% 
  filter(p_adjust<= 0.50) %>%
  filter(nes < 0) %>% 
  mutate(logq = -log10(p_adjust))

df = bind_rows(df_p10,
            df_neg)


row_clustered = df %>% 
  dplyr::select(condition, id, nes) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
              values_from= "nes") %>%
  column_to_rownames("id") %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  replace(is.na(.), 0) %>% 
  dist(.) %>% 
  hclust()

result_vac <- cluster_by_day(df, day_column = "day", condition_column = "condition") %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(day = fct_relevel(day, df$day %>% unique() %>% sort() %>% as.character()))


column_order <- c(result_vac$condition)

labels_day = df %>% 
  filter(id %in% row_clustered$labels) %>% 
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, column_order)) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = condition, y = 1, fill = day) + 
  geom_tile() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "0" = "white",
    "1" = "#caf0f8",
    "3" = "#90e0ef",
    "7" = "#0096c7")) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(y = "Day") +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none")


labels_organism = df %>% 
  filter(id %in% row_clustered$labels) %>% 
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, column_order)) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = condition, y = 1, fill = model) + 
  geom_tile() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Human"  = "#4DBBD5FF",
    "Mouse" = "#90A4AEFF",
    "FIT"   = "#CE1800FF"
  )) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(y = "Organism") +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none")

#Plot
dotplot = df %>% 
  filter(id %in% row_clustered$labels) %>% 
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, column_order),
                  id = fct_relevel(id, c(row_clustered$labels)),
         id = fct_rev(id)) %>% 
    mutate(signific = case_when(p_adjust <= 0.10 ~ "*",
                              p_adjust <= 0.25 ~ "-",
                              p_adjust <= 0.50 ~ "/",
                              p_adjust <= 0.05 ~ "**",
                              TRUE ~ "")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=condition, y = id, fill = nes, size = logq)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white",
            size = 0) + 
  geom_text(aes(label = signific), size = 4, vjust = 0.5, color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 8) ,
        axis.line  = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(x = "",
       y = "") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
  low = "#4DBBD5FF",      # azul para -1
  mid = "white",          # branco para 0
  high = "#DC0000FF",     # vermelho para +1
  midpoint = 0,
  oob = scales::squish,
  limits = c(-1, 2),      # fixa o intervalo
  name = "NES", ) +
  scale_y_discrete(position = "right") +
  scale_size(range = c(2, 6))
  

patch_immune_main_human_ImmuneGO = 
  labels_organism/
  labels_day/
  dotplot +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.08, 0.08, 5),
              guides = 'collect') +
  plot_annotation(title = "GSEA ImmuneGO_Human, Specific processes",
                  subtitle = "NES, padj<=0.10",
                  theme = theme(legend.position = "bottom",
                                plot.margin = margin(0.5, 0, 0.5, 1, unit = "cm"),
                                legend.direction = "horizontal", 
                                legend.box = "horizontal"))


patch_immune_main_human_ImmuneGO %>%
  ggsave(filename = here("Figures", "GSEA_ImmuneGO_Human_Specific.png"),
         width = 8,
         height = 15)
patch_immune_main_human_ImmuneGO
```

### Single gene


```{r}
X_all <- df_mouse %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = mm_entrez, values_from = fc_mm) %>%
  arrange(csp_id) %>% 
  select(-csp_id) 

y_target_all <- df_human %>%
  arrange(csp_id) %>% 
  select(csp_id, hs_entrez, fc_hs) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = hs_entrez, values_from = fc_hs) %>% 
  select(-csp_id) 

cor_matrix <- cor(X_all, y_target_all, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

cor_values = as.data.frame(cor_matrix) %>% 
  rownames_to_column("mm_entrez")


cor_values

```



```{r}
target_gene <- "26119"

X <- df_mouse %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = mm_entrez, values_from = fc_mm) %>%
  arrange(csp_id)

y_target <- df_human %>%
  filter(hs_entrez == target_gene) %>%
  select(csp_id, fc_hs) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(csp_id)

full_df <- inner_join(X, y_target, by = "csp_id")  %>% 
  select(csp_id, fc_hs, everything()) %>% 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~replace_na(., 0)))

train_df = full_df

# Correlation
top_genes <- cor_values %>% 
  select(mm_entrez, target_gene = target_gene) %>%
  slice_max(abs(target_gene), n = 100) %>% 
  pull(mm_entrez)

train_df <- full_df %>%
  select(all_of(c("csp_id", "fc_hs", top_genes))) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~replace_na(., 0)))

# Split into train and test
set.seed(123)
data_split <- initial_split(train_df, prop = 0.8)
train_data <- training(data_split)
test_data <- testing(data_split)
train_folds <- vfold_cv(train_data, repeats = 5)

# Recipe
rec <- recipe(fc_hs ~ ., data = train_data) %>%
  update_role(csp_id, new_role = "id") %>%
  step_normalize(all_predictors())
```




### Multiple genes


#### Random forest
```{r}
library(tidymodels)
library(vip)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)

model_rf_by_gene <- function(target_gene, df_mouse, df_human, top_n = 50) {
  
  rf_model <- rand_forest(mtry = tune(), trees = 500) %>%
    set_engine("ranger", importance = "permutation") %>%
    set_mode("regression")
  
  wf <- workflow() %>%
    add_recipe(rec) %>%
    add_model(rf_model)
  
  # CV
  set.seed(234)
  trees_folds <- vfold_cv(train_data, v = 5)
  mer_metrics <- metric_set(rmse, rsq)
  
  rf_tuned <- tune_grid(
    wf,
    metrics = mer_metrics,
    resamples = trees_folds,
    grid = 5
  )
  
  best_model <- select_best(rf_tuned, metric = "rmse")
  
  # Extraia os valores de RMSE e RSQ do melhor modelo
  best_metrics <- rf_tuned %>%
    collect_metrics() %>%
    filter(mtry == best_model$mtry)
  
  rmse_val <- best_metrics %>% filter(.metric == "rmse") %>% pull(mean)
  rsq_val  <- best_metrics %>% filter(.metric == "rsq")  %>% pull(mean)
  
  final_wf   <- finalize_workflow(wf, best_model)
  final_fit  <- fit(final_wf, train_data)
  final_model <- extract_fit_parsnip(final_fit)$fit
  
  preds <- predict(final_fit, test_data) %>%
  bind_cols(test_data)
  
  metrics_pred = metrics(preds, truth = fc_hs, estimate = .pred)
  
  
  # VIP com métricas adicionadas
  vi(final_model) %>%
    arrange(desc(Importance)) %>%
    mutate(hs_entrez = target_gene,
           rmse = rmse_val,
           rsq = rsq_val)
  
  
  vip_df <- vi(final_model) %>%
  arrange(desc(Importance)) %>% 
  mutate(hs_entrez = target_gene)
  
  results = vip_df %>% inner_join(HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez %>% 
               clean_names() %>% 
               select(hs_entrez = human_entrez,
                      hgnc_symbol) %>% 
               mutate(hs_entrez = as.character(hs_entrez)), 
             by = "hs_entrez") %>% 
  rename(mm_entrez = Variable) %>% 
  inner_join(HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez %>% 
               clean_names() %>% 
               select(mm_entrez = mouse_ortholog,
                      mm_symbol = mgi_symbol) %>% 
               mutate(mm_entrez = as.character(mm_entrez)), 
             by = "mm_entrez") %>% 
  select(hgnc_symbol, hs_entrez, Importance, mm_symbol, mm_entrez)  %>% 
    arrange(-Importance)
  results
  preds
  metrics_pred
}
```

#### Lasso

```{r}
library(tidymodels)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)


model_lasso_by_gene <- function(target_gene, X, df_human, top_n = 50, cor_values) {

  y_target <- df_human %>%
    filter(hs_entrez == target_gene) %>%
    select(csp_id, fc_hs) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    arrange(csp_id)

  full_df <- inner_join(X, y_target, by = "csp_id") %>%
    select(csp_id, fc_hs, everything()) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~replace_na(., 0)))

  if (nrow(full_df) < 10) return(NULL)  # ignora se poucos dados

  top_genes <- cor_values %>% 
  select(mm_entrez, target_gene = target_gene) %>%
  slice_max(abs(target_gene), n = 50) %>% 
  pull(mm_entrez)


  train_df <- full_df %>%
    select(all_of(c("csp_id", "fc_hs", top_genes))) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~replace_na(., 0)))

  # Split
  set.seed(123)
  data_split <- initial_split(train_df, prop = 0.8)
  train_data <- training(data_split)
  test_data  <- testing(data_split)

  rec <- recipe(fc_hs ~ ., data = train_data) %>%
    update_role(csp_id, new_role = "id") %>%
    step_normalize(all_predictors())

  # Modelo LASSO
  lasso_model <- linear_reg(penalty = tune(), mixture = 1) %>%
    set_engine("glmnet") %>%
    set_mode("regression")

  wf <- workflow() %>%
    add_recipe(rec) %>%
    add_model(lasso_model)

  set.seed(234)
  lasso_folds <- vfold_cv(train_data, v = 5)

  lambda_grid <- grid_regular(penalty(range = c(-4, 0)), levels = 20)

  mer_metrics <- metric_set(rmse, rsq)

  lasso_tuned <- tune_grid(
    wf,
    resamples = lasso_folds,
    metrics = mer_metrics,
    grid = lambda_grid
  )

  best_model <- select_best(lasso_tuned, metric = "rmse")

  best_metrics <- lasso_tuned %>%
    collect_metrics() %>%
    filter(penalty == best_model$penalty)

  rmse_val <- best_metrics %>% filter(.metric == "rmse") %>% pull(mean)

  final_wf <- finalize_workflow(wf, best_model)
  final_fit <- fit(final_wf, train_data)
  final_model <- extract_fit_parsnip(final_fit)$fit
  
  
  preds <- predict(final_fit, test_data) %>%
  bind_cols(test_data)
  
  metrics_pred = metrics(preds, truth = fc_hs, estimate = .pred)
  
  
  results = vip_df <- vi(final_model) %>%
  arrange(desc(Importance)) %>% 
  mutate(hs_entrez = target_gene) %>% 
inner_join(HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez %>% 
               clean_names() %>% 
               select(hs_entrez = human_entrez,
                      hgnc_symbol) %>% 
               mutate(hs_entrez = as.character(hs_entrez)), 
             by = "hs_entrez") %>% 
  rename(mm_entrez = Variable) %>% 
  inner_join(HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez %>% 
               clean_names() %>% 
               select(mm_entrez = mouse_ortholog,
                      mm_symbol = mgi_symbol) %>% 
               mutate(mm_entrez = as.character(mm_entrez)), 
             by = "mm_entrez") %>% 
  select(hgnc_symbol, hs_entrez, Importance, mm_symbol, mm_entrez) 

return(list(
    results = results,
    metrics_pred = metrics_pred,
    preds = preds
  ))
}
```

```{r}
library(glmnet)
library(tidyverse)
# Simular dados ----------------------------
set.seed(123)

n <- 100  # número de amostras
p <- 20   # número de preditores
k <- 3    # número de respostas

# Matriz X de preditores
X <- matrix(rnorm(n * p), nrow = n, ncol = p)
colnames(X) <- paste0("GeneM", 1:p)

# Gerar matriz Y com relação linear
B <- matrix(c(1.5, -2, 0.5, rep(0, p - 3)), nrow = p, ncol = k)
Y <- X %*% B + matrix(rnorm(n * k), nrow = n)

colnames(Y) <- paste0("GeneH", 1:k)

X
Y
```


```{r}
# Ajuste Lasso multivariado ----------------------------

# Ajuste com validação cruzada para escolher lambda ideal
cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(X, Y, family = "mgaussian", alpha = 1)

# Lambda ideal
best_lambda <- cv_fit$lambda.min
cat("Melhor lambda:", best_lambda, "\n")

# Previsões
preds <- predict(cv_fit, newx = X, s = "lambda.min")

# Converter para tibble
preds_df <- as_tibble(preds[,,1])  # 3D array -> 2D matrix
colnames(preds_df) <- paste0("Pred_", colnames(Y))

# Coeficientes
coefs <- coef(cv_fit, s = "lambda.min")  # Lista com 1 por resposta

# Combinar todos os coeficientes em uma tabela
coef_df <- map2_dfr(coefs, names(coefs), ~ {
  as.matrix(.x) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("Feature") %>%
    rename(Coefficient = 1) %>%
    mutate(Target = .y)
})


# Salvar objetos ----------------------------

write_csv(as_tibble(Y), "Y_true.csv")
write_csv(preds_df, "Y_pred.csv")
write_csv(coef_df, "lasso_coefficients.csv")

saveRDS(cv_fit, "lasso_multivariate_model.rds")

```

```{r}
  cor(df_mouse[[gene]], df_human[[gene]], use = "complete.obs")
})
names(cor_genes) <- colnames(df_mouse)
genes_filtered_corr <- names(cor_genes)[abs(cor_genes) > 0.75]

# Filtrar os dataframes mantendo somente os genes selecionados
df_mouse_filtered <- df_mouse[, genes_filtered_corr]
df_human_filtered <- df_human[, genes_filtered_corr]

# Conferir dimensões
dim(df_mouse_filtered)
dim(df_human_filtered)
length(genes_filtered_corr)
dim(df_mouse)

fit <- glmnet(
  x = df_mouse.matrix,

  family = "mgaussian",

)
```
